verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ׀ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר׀ אֶת־ דִּ֭בְרֵי הַזֹּ֑את הַשִּׁירָ֣ה לַיהוָ֗ה בְּי֤וֹם יְהוָ֘ה הִֽצִּיל־ אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־ אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל׃ וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ lə·ḏā·wiḏ lə·‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber ’eṯ- diḇ·rê haz·zōṯ haš·šî·rāh Yah·weh bə·yō·wm Yah·weh hiṣ·ṣîl- ’ō·w·ṯōw mik·kap̄ kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇāw ū·mî·yaḏ šā·’ūl way·yō·mar ’er·ḥā·mə·ḵā Yah·weh ḥiz·qî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster Of David the servant of the LORD who sang - - this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul He said I love You O LORD my strength

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה־ בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן־ יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh sal·‘î ū·mə·ṣū·ḏā·ṯî ū·mə·p̄al·ṭî ’ê·lî ṣū·rî ’e·ḥĕ·seh- bōw mā·ḡin·nî wə·qe·ren- yiš·‘î miś·gab·bî
verses.literal: The LORD is my rock my fortress and my deliverer My God [is] my rock in whom I take refuge my shield and the horn of my salvation my stronghold

verses.original: אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה מְ֭הֻלָּל אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃ וּמִן־ אֹ֝יְבַ֗י
verses.transliteration: ’eq·rā Yah·weh mə·hul·lāl ’iw·wā·šê·a‘ ū·min- ’ō·yə·ḇay
verses.literal: I will call upon the LORD [who is worthy] to be praised so shall I be saved from my enemies

verses.original: חֶבְלֵי־ מָ֑וֶת אֲפָפ֥וּנִי וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥeḇ·lê- mā·weṯ ’ă·p̄ā·p̄ū·nî wə·na·ḥă·lê ḇə·lî·ya·‘al yə·ḇa·‘ă·ṯū·nî
verses.literal: The cords of death encompassed me the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃ קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי
verses.transliteration: ḥeḇ·lê šə·’ō·wl sə·ḇā·ḇū·nî mō·wq·šê mā·weṯ qid·də·mū·nî
verses.literal: The cords of Sheol entangled me the snares of death confronted me

verses.original: בַּצַּר־ אֶֽקְרָ֣א לִ֤י׀ יְהוָה֮ וְאֶל־ אֱלֹהַ֪י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ יִשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו׀ תָּב֬וֹא בְאָזְנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: baṣ·ṣar- ’eq·rā lî Yah·weh wə·’el- ’ĕ·lō·hay ’ă·šaw·wê·a‘ mê·hê·ḵā·lōw yiš·ma‘ qō·w·lî wə·šaw·‘ā·ṯî lə·p̄ā·nāw tā·ḇō·w ḇə·’ā·zə·nāw
verses.literal: In my distress I called upon the LORD I cried to my God for help From His temple He heard my voice and my cry for His help . . . reached His ears

verses.original: הָאָ֗רֶץ וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ׀ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי־ חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tiḡ·‘aš wat·tir·‘aš ū·mō·ws·ḏê hā·rîm yir·gā·zū way·yiṯ·gā·‘ă·šū kî- ḥā·rāh lōw
verses.literal: Then the earth shook and quaked and the foundations of the mountains trembled they were shaken because He burned with anger

verses.original: עָשָׁ֨ן׀ עָ֘לָ֤ה בְּאַפּ֗וֹ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וְאֵשׁ־ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ מִפִּ֥יו גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·šān ‘ā·lāh bə·’ap·pōw tō·ḵêl wə·’êš- mim·men·nū mip·pîw ge·ḥā·lîm bā·‘ă·rū
verses.literal: Smoke rose from His nostrils and consuming fire came from His mouth glowing coals blazed forth

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yêṭ šā·ma·yim way·yê·raḏ wa·‘ă·rā·p̄el ta·ḥaṯ raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet

verses.original: וַיִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל־ כְּ֭רוּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝יֵּ֗דֶא עַל־ כַּנְפֵי־ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·kaḇ ‘al- kə·rūḇ way·yā·‘ōp̄ way·yê·ḏe ‘al- kan·p̄ê- rū·aḥ
verses.literal: He mounted . . . a cherub and flew He soared on the wings of the wind

verses.original: יָ֤שֶׁת חֹ֨שֶׁךְ׀ סִתְר֗וֹ מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃ סֻכָּת֑וֹ חֶשְׁכַת־ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥יו
verses.transliteration: yā·šeṯ ḥō·šeḵ siṯ·rōw ma·yim ‘ā·ḇê šə·ḥā·qîm suk·kā·ṯōw ḥeš·ḵaṯ- sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: He made darkness His hiding place [and] storm clouds - a canopy . . . around Him

verses.original: מִנֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥וֹ עָבָ֥יו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: min·nō·ḡah neḡ·dōw ‘ā·ḇāw ‘ā·ḇə·rū bā·rāḏ wə·ḡa·ḥă·lê- ’êš
verses.literal: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced hailstones and coals of fire

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה וַיַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם׀ קֹל֑וֹ וְ֭עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yar·‘êm baš·šā·ma·yim qō·lōw wə·‘el·yō·wn yit·tên bā·rāḏ wə·ḡa·ḥă·lê- ’êš
verses.literal: The LORD thundered from heaven the voice of the Most High resounded hailstones and coals of fire

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּיו וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם רָ֝ב וּבְרָקִ֥ים וַיְהֻמֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ḥiṣ·ṣāw way·p̄î·ṣêm rāḇ ū·ḇə·rā·qîm way·hum·mêm
verses.literal: He shot His arrows and scattered [the foes] He hurled lightning and routed them

verses.original: אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַיֵּ֤רָא֨וּ׀ מוֹסְד֪וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל וַֽיִּגָּלוּ֮ מִגַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·p̄î·qê ma·yim way·yê·rā·’ū mō·ws·ḏō·wṯ tê·ḇêl way·yig·gā·lū mig·ga·‘ă·rā·ṯə·ḵā Yah·weh min·niš·maṯ rū·aḥ ’ap·pe·ḵā
verses.literal: The channels of the sea appeared [and] the foundations of the world were exposed at Your rebuke O LORD at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗נִי רַבִּֽים׃ מִמַּ֥יִם
verses.transliteration: yiš·laḥ mim·mā·rō·wm yiq·qā·ḥê·nî yam·šê·nî rab·bîm mim·ma·yim
verses.literal: He reached down from on high and took hold of me He drew me out of deep waters

verses.original: יַצִּילֵ֗נִי עָ֑ז מֵאֹיְבִ֥י וּ֝מִשֹּׂנְאַ֗י כִּֽי־ אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: yaṣ·ṣî·lê·nî ‘āz mê·’ō·yə·ḇî ū·miś·śō·nə·’ay kî- ’ā·mə·ṣū mim·men·nî
verses.literal: He rescued me from my powerful enemy from foes - too mighty for me

verses.original: יְקַדְּמ֥וּנִי בְיוֹם־ אֵידִ֑י יְהוָ֖ה וַֽיְהִי־ לְמִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yə·qad·də·mū·nî ḇə·yō·wm- ’ê·ḏî Yah·weh way·hî- lə·miš·‘ān lî
verses.literal: They confronted me in my day of calamity but the LORD was my support

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי לַמֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗נִי כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣî·’ê·nî lam·mer·ḥāḇ yə·ḥal·lə·ṣê·nî kî ḥā·p̄êṣ bî
verses.literal: He brought me out into the open He rescued me because He delighted in me

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה יִגְמְלֵ֣נִי כְּצִדְקִ֑י יָשִׁ֥יב כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiḡ·mə·lê·nî kə·ṣiḏ·qî yā·šîḇ kə·ḇōr yā·ḏay lî
verses.literal: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî·šā- šā·mar·tî dar·ḵê Yah·weh wə·lō- rā·ša‘·tî mê·’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל־ מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י לֹא־ אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי׃ וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl miš·pā·ṭāw lə·neḡ·dî lō- ’ā·sîr men·nî wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw
verses.literal: For all His ordinances [are] before me I have not disregarded . . . His statutes

verses.original: וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ĕ·hî ṯā·mîm ‘im·mōw wā·’eš·tam·mêr mê·‘ă·wō·nî
verses.literal: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה וַיָּֽשֶׁב־ לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yā·šeḇ- lî ḵə·ṣiḏ·qî kə·ḇōr yā·ḏay lə·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight

verses.original: עִם־ חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־ גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im- ḥā·sîḏ tiṯ·ḥas·sāḏ ‘im- gə·ḇar tā·mîm tit·tam·mām
verses.literal: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful to . . . the blameless You show Yourself blameless

verses.original: עִם־ נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם־ עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im- nā·ḇār tiṯ·bā·rār wə·‘im- ‘iq·qêš tiṯ·pat·tāl
verses.literal: to the pure You show Yourself pure but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עָנִ֣י עַם־ תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃ רָמ֣וֹת וְעֵינַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ṯō·wō·šî·a‘ ‘ā·nî ‘am- taš·pîl rā·mō·wṯ wə·‘ê·na·yim
verses.literal: For You save an afflicted people but You humble those with haughty eyes

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה יְהוָ֥ה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh tā·’îr nê·rî ’ĕ·lō·hay yag·gî·ah ḥā·šə·kî
verses.literal: For You O LORD light my lamp my God lights up my darkness

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג־ שֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇə·ḵā ’ā·ruṣ gə·ḏūḏ ū·ḇê·lō·hay ’ă·ḏal·leḡ- šūr
verses.literal: For in You I can charge an army and with my God I can scale a wall

verses.original: הָאֵל֮ דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ תָּמִ֪ים אִמְרַֽת־ יְהוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה ה֝֗וּא מָגֵ֥ן לְכֹ֤ל׀ הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl dar·kōw tā·mîm ’im·raṯ- Yah·weh ṣə·rū·p̄āh hū mā·ḡên lə·ḵōl ha·ḥō·sîm bōw
verses.literal: [As for] God His way is perfect the word of the LORD is flawless He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mî ’ĕ·lō·w·ah mib·bal·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh ū·mî ṣūr zū·lā·ṯî ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: For who is God besides the LORD And who [is] the Rock except our God

verses.original: הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן דַּרְכִּֽי׃ תָּמִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl ham·’az·zə·rê·nî ḥā·yil way·yit·tên dar·kî tā·mîm
verses.literal: [It is] God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear

verses.original: מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי׃ וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י
verses.transliteration: mə·šaw·weh raḡ·lay kā·’ay·yā·lō·wṯ ya·‘ă·mî·ḏê·nî wə·‘al bā·mō·ṯay
verses.literal: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights

verses.original: מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי׃ וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת־ נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה
verses.transliteration: mə·lam·mêḏ yā·ḏay lam·mil·ḥā·māh zə·rō·w·‘ō·ṯāy wə·ni·ḥă·ṯāh qe·šeṯ- nə·ḥū·šāh
verses.literal: He trains my hands for battle my arms can bend a bow of bronze

verses.original: וַתִּתֶּן־ לִי֮ מָגֵ֪ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥ךָ וִֽימִינְךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑נִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tit·ten- lî mā·ḡên yiš·‘e·ḵā wî·mî·nə·ḵā ṯis·‘ā·ḏê·nî wə·‘an·waṯ·ḵā ṯar·bê·nî
verses.literal: You have given me Your shield of salvation Your right hand upholds me and Your gentleness exalts me

verses.original: תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣י תַחְתָּ֑י קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃ וְלֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ
verses.transliteration: tar·ḥîḇ ṣa·‘ă·ḏî ṯaḥ·tāy qar·sul·lāy wə·lō mā·‘ă·ḏū
verses.literal: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way

verses.original: אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ אָ֝שׁוּב עַד־ כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’er·dō·wp̄ ’ō·wy·ḇay wə·’aś·śî·ḡêm wə·lō- ʾå̄·šūḇ ‘aḏ- kal·lō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: I pursued my enemies and overtook them I did not turn back until they were consumed

verses.original: אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא־ יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’em·ḥā·ṣêm wə·lō- yuḵ·lū qūm yip·pə·lū ta·ḥaṯ raḡ·lāy
verses.literal: I crushed them so they could not . . . rise they have fallen under my feet

verses.original: וַתְּאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חַ֭יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣י תַּחְתָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·’az·zə·rê·nî ḥa·yil lam·mil·ḥā·māh taḵ·rî·a‘ qā·may taḥ·tāy
verses.literal: You have armed me with strength for battle You have subdued my foes beneath me

verses.original: נָתַ֣תָּה וְֽאֹיְבַ֗י עֹ֑רֶף לִּ֣י אַצְמִיתֵֽם׃ וּ֝מְשַׂנְאַ֗י
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯat·tāh wə·’ō·yə·ḇay ‘ō·rep̄ lî ’aṣ·mî·ṯêm ū·mə·śan·’ay
verses.literal: You have made my enemies retreat before me I destroyed those who hated me

verses.original: יְשַׁוְּע֥וּ וְאֵין־ מוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עַל־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְלֹ֣א עָנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·šaw·wə·‘ū wə·’ên- mō·wō·šî·a‘ ‘al- Yah·weh wə·lō ‘ā·nām
verses.literal: They cried for help but [there was] no one to save them to the LORD but He did not answer

verses.original: וְֽאֶשְׁחָקֵ֗ם כְּעָפָ֥ר עַל־ פְּנֵי־ ר֑וּחַ אֲרִיקֵֽם׃ כְּטִ֖יט חוּצ֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: wə·’eš·ḥā·qêm kə·‘ā·p̄ār ‘al- pə·nê- rū·aḥ ’ă·rî·qêm kə·ṭîṭ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind I trampled them like mud in the streets

verses.original: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי֮ מֵרִ֪יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵנִי לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם עַ֖ם לֹא־ יָדַ֣עְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: tə·p̄al·lə·ṭê·nî mê·rî·ḇê ‘ām tə·śî·mê·nî lə·rōš gō·w·yim ‘am lō- yā·ḏa‘·tî ya·‘aḇ·ḏū·nî
verses.literal: You have delivered me from the strife of the people You have made me the head of nations a people I had not known shall serve me

verses.original: לְשֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑י בְּנֵֽי־ נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šê·ma‘ ’ō·zen yiš·šā·mə·‘ū lî bə·nê- nê·ḵār yə·ḵa·ḥă·šū- lî
verses.literal: When they hear me . . . they obey me foreigners . . . cower before me

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- nê·ḵār yib·bō·lū wə·yaḥ·rə·ḡū mim·mis·gə·rō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: Foreigners . . . lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה חַי־ וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃ וְ֝יָר֗וּם
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ḥay- ū·ḇā·rūḵ ṣū·rî ’ĕ·lō·w·hê yiš·‘î wə·yā·rūm
verses.literal: The LORD lives and blessed be my Rock And {may} the God of my salvation be exalted

verses.original: הָאֵ֗ל הַנּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑י וַיַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl han·nō·w·ṯên nə·qā·mō·wṯ lî way·yaḏ·bêr ‘am·mîm taḥ·tāy
verses.literal: the God who avenges . . . me and subdues nations beneath me

verses.original: מְפַלְּטִ֗י מִן־ מֵאֹ֫יְבָ֥י אַ֣ף תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑נִי קָ֭מַי תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃ חָ֝מָ֗ס מֵאִ֥ישׁ
verses.transliteration: mə·p̄al·lə·ṭî min- mê·’ō·yə·ḇāy ’ap̄ tə·rō·wm·mê·nî qā·may taṣ·ṣî·lê·nî ḥā·mās mê·’îš
verses.literal: who delivers me from my enemies . . . You exalt me above my foes You rescue me from violent men

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֤ן׀ אוֹדְךָ֖ יְהוָ֑ה בַגּוֹיִ֥ם׀ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃ וּלְשִׁמְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ō·wḏ·ḵā Yah·weh ḇag·gō·w·yim ’ă·zam·mê·rāh ū·lə·šim·ḵā
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I will praise You O LORD among the nations I will sing praises to Your name

verses.original: מַגְדִּל יְשׁוּע֪וֹת מַ֫לְכּ֥וֹ וְעֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד׀ לִמְשִׁיח֗וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֗וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: maḡ·dil yə·šū·‘ō·wṯ mal·kōw wə·‘ō·śeh ḥe·seḏ lim·šî·ḥōw lə·ḏā·wiḏ ū·lə·zar·‘ōw ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Great salvation {He brings to} His king He shows loving devotion to His anointed to David and his descendants forever . . .
